title: Handle edge cases and error conditions
description:
Robust error handling for flow visualization:

Edge cases to handle:
1. Very large graphs (>500 issues) - warn or paginate
2. Circular dependencies - detect and report clearly
3. Missing target issues in relationships - skip or warn
4. Empty repository - friendly message
5. No issues with dependencies - show standalone list
6. Invalid --goal ID - clear error message
7. Goal has no path to roots - report and explain

For each:
- Write clear, actionable error messages
- Add unit tests
- Document behavior in help text

Error messages should guide users to fix the issue, not just report it.
